description: Remove a module: its pods stop and it leaves the project and its CORS origins. DESTRUCTIVE. One operation runs on a module at a time, and none beside an operation on its project: the refusal names the running job; wait for it with get_job_status, then call again. While RationalBloks is being updated, the call is refused with 'RationalBloks is being updated': call it again in a few minutes.
name: delete_module
title: Delete Module
